mapper.select: SELECT TOP 1 CAST(p.GUID AS varchar(36)) AS guid, CAST(p.TypeGUID AS varchar(36)) AS typeGuid, CAST(p.ProductUnitGUID AS varchar(36)) AS productUnitGuid, CAST(p.DefaultSupplierGUID AS varchar(36)) AS defaultSupplierGuid, CAST(p.DefaultDepotGUID AS varchar(36)) AS defaultDepotGuid, p.[No] AS [no], p.Barcode AS barcode, p.[Name] AS [name], p.NameP AS nameP, p.Combinable AS combinable, p.PackageQuantity AS packageQuantity, p.QuantityBk AS quantityBk, p.InvoiceQuantityBk AS invoiceQuantityBk, p.PurchasePrice AS purchasePrice, p.PurchasePriceTax AS purchasePriceTax, p.TaxRate AS taxRate FROM dbo.Products p WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(p.Barcode, ''))) = #{barcode} ORDER BY p.UpdateTime DESC, p.GUID DESC

SELECT TOP 1 CAST(p.GUID AS varchar(36)) AS guid, CAST(p.TypeGUID AS varchar(36)) AS typeGuid, CAST(p.ProductUnitGUID AS varchar(36)) AS productUnitGuid, CAST(p.DefaultSupplierGUID AS varchar(36)) AS defaultSupplierGuid, CAST(p.DefaultDepotGUID AS varchar(36)) AS defaultDepotGuid, p.[No] AS [no], p.Barcode AS barcode, p.[Name] AS [name], p.NameP AS nameP, p.Combinable AS combinable, p.PackageQuantity AS packageQuantity, p.QuantityBk AS quantityBk, p.InvoiceQuantityBk AS invoiceQuantityBk, p.PurchasePrice AS purchasePrice, p.PurchasePriceTax AS purchasePriceTax, p.TaxRate AS taxRate FROM dbo.Products p WHERE p.[No] = #{productNo} ORDER BY p.UpdateTime DESC, p.GUID DESC

SELECT TOP 1 p.[No] FROM dbo.Products p WHERE LEN(p.[No]) = #{codeLength} AND (#{prefixLen} = 0 OR LEFT(p.[No], #{prefixLen}) = #{prefix}) AND SUBSTRING(p.[No], #{prefixLen} + 1, #{codeLength} - #{prefixLen}) NOT LIKE '%[^0-9]%' ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING(p.[No], #{prefixLen} + 1, #{codeLength} - #{prefixLen}) AS BIGINT) DESC
